suite.name: SCG Ping-Pong RTT Suite
suite.description: Measures closed-loop round-trip time (RTT) with a single message in flight per connection (window = 1). The client sends one message, waits for the echo, and records the elapsed monotonic time; the next send only happens after the reply arrives. Unlike the throughput and latency suites (which keep the pipe full and measure one-way processing latency under load), ping-pong captures the true request/response turnaround a request/reply protocol experiences, including both directions of the path. Throughput-oriented calibration and saturation sweeps are skipped because they measure bandwidth, not turnaround. Loopback TCP and UDP only: the DTLS/UDP gateway path has no return rule and is not exercised here.
suite.author: SESHAT
